en_title: Epic Games Boss Tim Sweeney Doubles Down on Valve Criticism, Says Steam's AI Content Disclosure Is a 'Political Act'
cn_title: Epic老板再批AI披露是政治行为
subtitle: 消费者知情权之争
opus_summary: Epic老板斯维尼再批Steam的AI内容披露政策，称其为政治行为，并指其损害开发者收入。开发者反驳称消费者有权知情，Valve则始终保持沉默。

paragraphs.en: Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney spent the weekend doubling down on his severe criticism of Valve, calling Steam’s AI content disclosure a “political act.”
paragraphs.cn: Epic Games老板蒂姆·斯维尼在周末继续猛烈批评Valve，称Steam的AI内容披露是「政治行为」。

paragraphs.en: The controversial majority owner of Epic is all in on AI, having recently triggered a “huge pivot” of the company to retool it for “maximum AI acceleration,” Sweeney said . Epic is a long-standing rival of Gabe Newell’s Valve, with the Epic Games Store struggling to make a dent in Steam’s dominance over the PC gaming market even as it offers developers more financially beneficial terms.
paragraphs.cn: 这位备受争议的Epic控股股东正全力投入AI。斯维尼表示，他最近推动公司「大幅转型」，调整业务以「最大限度加速AI发展」。Epic长期以来一直是加布·纽维尔旗下Valve的竞争对手，但即便Epic Games商城为开发者提供了经济上更有利的条件，也仍难以撼动Steam在PC游戏市场的主导地位。

paragraphs.en: Sweeney is particularly upset with Steam’s AI content disclosure policy, which requires developers to disclose the use of AI in “creating content that ships with your game, and is consumed by players.” This includes content such as artwork, sound, narrative, and localization. It does not include “efficiency gains” through the use of AI tools.
paragraphs.cn: 斯维尼尤其不满Steam的AI内容披露政策。该政策要求开发者披露是否使用AI「创作随游戏一同交付、供玩家体验的内容」，包括美术、声音、叙事和本地化等，但不包括使用AI工具带来的「效率提升」。

paragraphs.en: On Friday, Sweeney hit out at Valve’s policy , saying “forcing developers to write a political statement to be used against them by the hate mob they’re helping organize is abhorrent.” This statement sparked a backlash online, with a number of people — developers included — confused by the suggestion that an AI disclosure was political in any way, and insisting that Valve was only providing clarity its customers wanted.
paragraphs.cn: 周五，斯维尼抨击Valve的政策，称「强迫开发者写下政治声明，再让Valve协助集结的仇恨暴民拿这些声明攻击开发者，这种做法令人憎恶」。这番话在网上引发反弹，包括开发者在内的不少人不理解披露AI使用情况究竟哪里涉及政治，并强调Valve只是在按消费者的意愿提供清晰的信息。

paragraphs.en: “Customers have a right to know what they’re buying,” David Goldfarb, founder of Metal Hellsinger developer The Outsiders and former Battlefield developer, replied. “They still bought Arc Raiders, they will definitely buy games they want to buy, AI use or no. Does it disadvantage small teams who need to leverage AI to survive? Jury’s out. Calling it a hate mob is far-fetched.”
paragraphs.cn: 《重金属：地狱歌手》开发商The Outsiders的创始人、曾参与《战地风云》开发的David Goldfarb回复道：「消费者有权知道自己买的是什么。他们照样买了《ARC Raiders》，无论游戏有没有用AI，他们肯定还是会买自己想买的游戏。这会让那些需要借助AI才能生存的小团队处于不利地位吗？现在还没有定论。但把这些人称为仇恨暴民就太牵强了。」

paragraphs.en: Undeterred, Sweeney issued a number of social media posts defending his position, saying AI disclosures are “just as partisan as mandatory political essays or forcing developers to list their voting history to drive cancel campaigns and public struggle sessions.”
paragraphs.cn: 斯维尼并未退让，而是接连在社交媒体上发帖为自己的立场辩护，称AI披露「和强制撰写政治文章，或强迫开发者列出投票记录、借此发动抵制和公开批斗一样，都带有政治倾向」。

paragraphs.en: When one person challenged Sweeney on this, accusing him of being "anti-consumer" for forcing something consumers don't like on them, the Fortnite boss compared Steam's AI disclosures to Valve forcing developers to list their political affiliations.
paragraphs.cn: 有人就此质疑斯维尼，指责他把消费者不喜欢的东西强加给他们，是「反消费者」的做法。这位《堡垒之夜》掌舵人则将Steam的AI披露政策比作Valve强迫开发者公开政治派别。

paragraphs.en: "Say there is a large contingent of gamers that don’t like democrats or, equivalently, republicans. Should Valve force developers to list their political affiliation? Is that pro-consumer? Do you think that policy would have a positive effect on gaming?" he said . As you can imagine, this statement was ridiculed in the replies, with one person saying "equating AI to how a person votes is pure cope gymnastics."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「假设有一大批玩家不喜欢民主党人，或者反过来，不喜欢共和党人。Valve就应该强迫开发者公开自己的政治派别吗？这就是维护消费者利益吗？你们觉得这样的政策会对游戏产生积极影响吗？」不难想象，这番话在回复中遭到了嘲讽。一名用户表示：「把AI和一个人如何投票相提并论，纯粹是在强词夺理地自我安慰。」

paragraphs.en: Again, undeterred, Sweeney claimed that Valve is hitting developer revenue by “undermining their business with these AI hate campaigns,” insisting on “a real economic cost to Valve’s foray into forced political disclosures.”
paragraphs.cn: 斯维尼依然没有退让。他声称，Valve正「通过这些针对AI的仇恨行动破坏开发者的生意」，导致开发者收入受损，并坚称「Valve推行强制政治披露，确实造成了经济损失」。

paragraphs.en: He continued : “a substantial number of users would love to have mandatory political opinion disclosures for developers, with several saying they take it upon themselves to surface this info in reviews since it’s not disclosed on product pages.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「相当多的用户都希望强制开发者披露政治观点。有几个人表示，因为产品页面没有披露这些信息，他们便主动在评论中将其公开。

paragraphs.en: “The primary use of both categories of disclosures is to drive cancel campaigns against games and deprive them of revenue and livelihood unless they get onboard with the movement’s political goals. Yes, blocking free choice to adopt productive technology is a political act.”
paragraphs.cn: 「这两类披露的主要用途，都是发动针对游戏的抵制行动，剥夺开发者的收入和生计，除非他们接受这场运动的政治目标。没错，阻止人们自由选择采用能提高生产力的技术，就是政治行为。」

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Epic revealed a newly refreshed version of the Epic Games Launcher , its Steam-like platform that provides access to the Epic Games Store, your games library, social features, and a developer’s hub. And, in keeping with the company’s push for AI-assisted development , this new version of the launcher was created using generative artificial intelligence. “Programming is hard,” wrote Epic in a new blog post . “So, instead of doing that, we vibe coded a new Epic Games Launcher that’s way faster and more responsive than the current one, and has a new look.”
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，Epic公布了焕然一新的Epic Games启动器。这个类似Steam的平台可供用户访问Epic Games商城、游戏库、社交功能和开发者中心。与公司推动AI辅助开发的方向一致，新版启动器使用生成式AI制作。Epic在一篇新博文中写道：「编程很难。所以，我们没有自己写代码，而是通过氛围编程（vibe coding）做了一个新的Epic Games启动器。它比现有版本快得多、响应更灵敏，还换了新面貌。」

paragraphs.en: Epic then launched an Unreal Engine vibe coding contest with an image of a six-fingered hand, presumably as a joke about poor quality AI images.
paragraphs.cn: 随后，Epic推出了一场Unreal Engine氛围编程竞赛，配图是一只长着六根手指的手，想必是在拿质量低劣的AI图片开玩笑。

paragraphs.en: The 2026 Epic AI MegaJam begins Nov 12: https://t.co/aAXEqj7zmE https://t.co/h3Kgs9Y5zH
paragraphs.cn: 2026年Epic AI MegaJam将于11月12日开始：https://t.co/aAXEqj7zmE https://t.co/h3Kgs9Y5zH

paragraphs.en: Through it all, Valve has done what it does best: remain quiet. The long-running joke that Gabe Newell simply sits back and waits for his competitors to make mistakes seems particularly relevant here, as Tim Sweeney continues to tweet his outrage over Valve and Steam. Meanwhile, earlier this month Steam broke its all-time record for concurrent users yet again, with 43.5 million people logged in at the same time.
paragraphs.cn: 在这整个过程中，Valve做了它最擅长的事：保持沉默。一直以来，人们都开玩笑说，加布·纽维尔只需坐等竞争对手犯错。眼下蒂姆·斯维尼不断发帖表达对Valve和Steam的愤怒，这个老笑话似乎格外应景。与此同时，Steam在本月早些时候再次刷新同时在线用户数纪录，达到4,350万人。
